decisions.reason: Attributes the single TypeError to plugin A's unconditional useSessionPendingInteraction(...) call; contract diff shows alpha.2 removed it, folded into useSessionStatus, useSessions stays; plugin B uses no standard-kit hooks and throws nothing; no claim that useSessions was removed.

Explains one list slot under ONE shared DrawerErrorBoundary with null fallback unmounting the whole subtree, so B chips vanish with A strip; attach button survives via the separate input.left boundary; quotes the host log line 'boundary fallback active; unmounted entries: dsh-paste-input-dock, progress'.

Reads disable-A experiment as proving render-crash coupling and B's innocence; explicitly lists what it does not prove (B fully alpha.2-compatible, only dock defect); explains reinstalling B could never help since B was never broken; refutes the colleague's both-plugins theory since B uses no kit hooks.

Corrected code reads pending via useSessionStatus(...)?.pendingInteraction with feature detection and stable empty fallbacks, never calling a missing seat; degradation matrix shows only pending indicators hide while running/todos/token/ETA keep working; silent degradation justified by shared-boundary co-tenant unmount; also guards legacy hook.

Client-bundle fix, no host restart, hard refresh required (boundary latched until switch); checks both entries render together and B regression covers paste/remove/re-paste with A enabled; hygiene: feature-detect all kit hooks, optional local boundary, host per-entry boundaries with blast-radius/observability trade-offs.

caps.reason: Final remedy fixes plugin A's component; plugin B is explicitly ruled out as never broken, and the two symptoms are presented as one cause, not independent breakages.
